article.headline: Brighton targets Carabao Cup revenge against Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium
article.summary: Brighton and Manchester City face off at the Etihad Stadium this afternoon following a midweek Carabao Cup penalty defeat.
article.body: Brighton enters the Etihad Stadium today seeking immediate retribution after falling to Manchester City on penalties just three days ago. The midweek Carabao Cup clash concluded with Manchester City advancing, leaving Brighton to quickly regroup for this Premier League fixture.  The importance of today's encounter is magnified by the tight turnaround between domestic cup action and league play. For both clubs, securing points today is vital as they navigate a busy schedule that includes eight total Premier League matches taking place across this Saturday. Fans will be watching closely to see if Brighton can overcome the psychological weight of their recent shootout loss or if Manchester City will maintain their momentum at home. According to The Guardian, the match serves as a high-stakes rematch following the Wednesday night contest. BBC Sport notes that coverage of the game will be available to listeners on BBC Radio 5 Live. The game is part of a broader day of fixtures, as teams across the country compete to improve their standing in the 2026-27 season. Supporters have various digital avenues to track real-time results throughout the afternoon, including the BBC Sport app. The outcome will likely influence the momentum of both squads as they transition into the next stage of the league season. With the teams familiar with each other's tactics after the midweek battle, adjustments made by the managers in the short time between games could prove decisive in determining the final result at the Etihad.

article.headline: Estevao earns first Premier League start as Chelsea host Manchester United today
article.summary: Chelsea and Manchester United face off in the Premier League with Estevao and Bruno Fernandes returning to their respective starting lineups.
article.body:
Estevao makes his first Premier League start of the season for Chelsea while captain Bruno Fernandes returns to lead Manchester United after being dropped last weekend. Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has opted for four changes to his side following their EFL Cup defeat at Liverpool, bringing in defenders Levi Colwill and Marco Palestra alongside the returning Cole Palmer. The team will start with Penders in goal, supported by a defensive line of Acheampong, Fofana, Colwill, and Palestra, while Caicedo and Lavia hold the midfield positions behind an attacking front of Estevao, Palmer, Neto, and Rogers.

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has made three changes to his starting XI. Beyond Fernandes, Lisandro Martinez and Matheus Cunha are also back in the lineup. Lammens starts in goal behind a defense featuring Yoro, Maguire, Martinez, and Dalot. The midfield duo of Santos and Baleba will support an attack consisting of Amad, Fernandes, Cunha, and Mbeumo. Notable absences for United include Kobbie Mainoo, who remains on the bench despite recovering from an injury that sidelined him for four matches.

The tactical setup highlights distinct shifts for both clubs as they look to secure points in a congested Premier League table. Chelsea faces the challenge of adapting without Maxence Lacroix, who is sidelined with a hamstring injury sustained at Anfield, and the surprise omission of Jordan Henderson from the squad entirely. Manchester United fans have expressed mixed reactions to the team selection, specifically concerning Carrick’s use of defensive personnel in wide positions. With both teams looking for stability, the result today will carry significant weight for the remainder of the league campaign.

article.headline: Diana Shnaider Claws Back from Near Defeat to Clinch Tokyo Semifinal Spot
article.summary: Diana Shnaider rallied to beat Alexandra Eala 2-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in a grueling 2-hour and 52-minute quarterfinal on Friday.
article.body:
In a match featuring 88 total groundstroke winners, Diana Shnaider overcame a massive deficit to defeat Alexandra Eala in the Toray Pan Pacific Open quarterfinals. Shnaider found herself just two points away from elimination during a tense second-set tiebreak before rallying to turn the momentum in her favor. By the third set, the Russian player tightened her game significantly, committing only two unforced errors to close out the contest.

This victory marks Shnaider’s fifth semifinal appearance of the 2026 season. For tennis fans, the matchup is becoming a must-watch event, as the two rising stars have now faced off in intense battles for two consecutive weeks. Following her victory at the BNB Ningbo Open earlier in October, Shnaider has now established a 2-0 record in this emerging rivalry.

According to the WTA, the match displayed a high level of technical skill from both sides. Eala initially dominated the opening set, demonstrating strong defensive prowess by fending off eight break points and stringing together five consecutive games. However, Shnaider remained persistent, noting after the match that she focused on fighting for every point despite facing an opponent she described as playing at an insane level.

Shnaider now advances to face 18-year-old Slovakian wild card Mia Pohankova. Pohankova reached the final four after a notable victory against qualifier Alycia Parks. Meanwhile, Eala is set to turn her attention toward the upcoming Hong Kong Tennis Open following her exit in Tokyo.

While Miami continues to dominate, North Carolina is looking to rebound from a heartbreaking 31-30 overtime loss to Syracuse last weekend. The Tar Heels, currently 4-3, have already matched their total win count from the previous season but face a daunting challenge against the nation’s 11th-ranked scoring defense.

This matchup holds significant weight for the local community, as the convergence of game day and Halloween celebrations is expected to draw heavy pedestrian traffic to Franklin Street. Local business owners and law enforcement are bracing for the influx, with officials deploying additional police and fire personnel to manage the anticipated congestion. For retailers like the century-old Sutton's Drug Store, the event serves as a festive anchor, drawing students and fans into the historic heart of Chapel Hill.

According to CBS Sports, Miami enters the game as 14-point favorites, backed by a defense that allows just 2.4 yards per rush. The SportsLine Projection Model notes that while Miami’s offense has been explosive, the game could trend toward a lower-scoring affair, as the model projects the total to fall under the 53.5-point line in 53% of simulations. North Carolina will rely on a disciplined defensive unit that has held back-to-back opponents under a 60% completion rate this season.

article.body: Raphinha powered the Catalan attack by netting a brace to dismantle the Alavés defense in a lopsided encounter. The scoreline was further padded by goals from Lamine Yamal, Fermín, and Gordon, confirming a clinical performance that left the visitors with little room to maneuver throughout the match. This commanding win marks a significant shift in the league standings, placing Barcelona back at the summit of the table under manager Hansi Flick. The team's ability to convert multiple opportunities highlights their current offensive form as they push to consolidate their position in the title race. According to El Correo, the match saw Raphinha open the scoring early with a left-footed strike from close range, setting the tone for a one-sided affair that the visitor's side struggled to counter. El País reports that while Mariano managed to soften the final result for Alavés, the sheer volume of goals from Barcelona ensured the outcome was never in doubt. The loss forces Alavés to regroup as they look for more consistency in their defensive organization against top-tier opponents. Barcelona continues their domestic campaign with the momentum gained from this substantial margin of victory, aiming to maintain their defensive and offensive efficiency in upcoming fixtures.

article.headline: No. 1 Nebraska Volleyball Sets Historic 53-Match Regular-Season Winning Streak Record
article.summary: Nebraska volleyball defeated Michigan on Friday night to secure a record-breaking 53rd consecutive regular-season victory.
article.body:
A crowd of 12,707 fans watched at the Crisler Center as Nebraska overcame a first-set loss to storm past Michigan in four sets, finishing 26-28, 25-20, 25-20, 25-14. The win, the 53rd straight for the team in the regular season, officially breaks the previous program record of 52 consecutive victories set during the 2004 and 2005 seasons. This latest result also extends the team's current undefeated streak to 22-0 on the year.

The unbeaten streak remains a critical barometer for the top-ranked Huskers as they defend their standing in the Big Ten. Beyond the record, the match at Michigan marked the second-ever sellout at the venue, matching an attendance high set by the same matchup in 2025. With this momentum, Nebraska maintains its dominance in road and neutral-site matches, now holding a 24-game winning streak that ranks 11th all-time in NCAA history.

According to the official athletics website, the team showcased a balanced offensive effort with five players recording double-digit kills. Virginia Adriano led the charge with a career-high 14 kills, while Harper Murray added 16 kills to the effort. Andi Jackson reached a personal milestone during the match, becoming the 13th Husker in the rally-scoring era to eclipse 1,000 career kills. Setter Bergen Reilly facilitated the high-efficiency attack, which hit .412 overall, by contributing 58 assists and nine digs.

The Huskers have little time to rest following their Friday night performance. The top-ranked squad moves on to face Michigan State on Saturday as they look to protect their unblemished record.

article.headline: Second Storm System Brings Widespread Flood Risk Across Arizona This Weekend
article.summary: Phoenix will see rain chances increase Saturday night through Sunday as a second storm system moves through the region.
article.body:
Residents across Arizona should prepare for a long-duration rain event that arrives Saturday night and continues through Sunday. While Saturday begins with quiet, partly cloudy conditions, moisture will push into the region by the evening, bringing widespread rainfall that is expected to continue through the following day. This secondary storm system follows an initial round of thunderstorms that triggered a flood warning for the northeast Valley and Maricopa County.

A flood watch covers most of Arizona from Saturday night through Monday morning, highlighting a persistent risk of flooding in urban areas, canyons, and low water crossings. Because this event involves on-and-off rain for several hours, water accumulation could occur even if the individual storms are not considered severe. Drivers and residents in low-lying areas should remain alert as river levels are expected to rise to flood stage in certain spots.

Temperatures in Phoenix are expected to drop throughout the weekend, with a high of 78 degrees on Saturday followed by a high of 70 degrees on Sunday. According to AZ Family and FOX 10 Phoenix, the rain will begin to move out of the area by Sunday evening, though lingering showers may persist in eastern Arizona into Monday morning. The start of the workweek should remain quiet in Phoenix as drier air moves into the region. For those planning outdoor activities, trick-or-treat hours are currently expected to be dry for most of the state before the moisture arrives.

article.headline: Hot 5-1 Philadelphia 76ers storm Spectrum Center to face struggling Charlotte Hornets
article.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers face the Charlotte Hornets at the Spectrum Center on Saturday night in an Eastern Conference NBA matchup.
article.body:
Tyrese Maxey enters the matchup averaging more than 28 points per game, spearheading a Philadelphia offense that has surged to a 5-1 record. The 76ers arrive in Charlotte following a gritty 98-93 victory over the New York Knicks on Friday night, marking their fourth win in five games.

This Saturday night clash carries significant implications for the Eastern Conference standings as Philadelphia looks to maintain its championship momentum. For the Charlotte Hornets, the game represents a critical opportunity to regain footing after enduring back-to-back losses against the Detroit Pistons and Washington Wizards. With the 76ers playing on the second night of a back-to-back, the Hornets aim to leverage home-court advantage at the Spectrum Center to disrupt Philadelphia's rhythm.

According to Yahoo Sports, Charlotte relies heavily on Brandon Miller, who is currently averaging more than 24 points per game. However, the Hornets face depth challenges due to recent injuries affecting their supporting cast. To secure a win, Charlotte must execute a high-level defensive game plan and maintain efficient scoring against a Philadelphia roster anchored by the paint dominance of Joel Embiid. Both teams are navigating the fatigue of consecutive nights of play.

The game is scheduled to tip off at 6 p.m. ET. Fans can watch the live broadcast on NBA TV, with additional streaming options available through platforms like Fubo for those looking to follow the action in real time.

article.headline: Coventry City Rout Sunderland 3-1 to Escape Premier League Relegation Zone
article.summary: Coventry climbed out of the relegation zone after defeating Sunderland 3-1 with goals from Tatsuhiro Sakamoto, Taiwo Awoniyi, and Jack Rudoni.
article.body: Coventry players finished with clinical precision as Tatsuhiro Sakamoto netted his first Premier League goal from the edge of the box, setting the tone for a dominant display at the Coventry Building Society Arena. While Sunderland struggled to find rhythm, Coventry capitalized on defensive errors, including a decisive moment where Taiwo Awoniyi dispossessed Luke O'Nien to secure his first league goal for the club. This victory was finalized by Jack Rudoni, whose deflected strike in the 52nd minute pushed the lead to three goals. By the time Enzo Le Fee converted a late penalty for the visitors—Sunderland’s first league goal since September 20—the result was firmly in Coventry’s favor. The match ended with further frustration for Sunderland as Omar Alderete received a second yellow card, cementing the team's position at the bottom of the league. Manager Frank Lampard praised his squad's professional execution from the opening whistle to the final minute of play. This result serves as a vital lifeline for Coventry, who have successfully leapfrogged teams including Manchester United to exit the bottom three of the Premier League table. For Sunderland, the defeat continues a difficult campaign as they remain winless at the foot of the standings, despite manager Regis Le Bris looking for ways to revitalize their struggling attack. The win marks Coventry's third Premier League victory of the season, providing significant momentum as the league campaign progresses. The team will look to build on this performance in upcoming fixtures as they aim to solidify their place outside the relegation zone.

article.headline: Gamecocks Storm Norman as South Carolina Faces Oklahoma in Week 9 Clash
article.summary: South Carolina meets Oklahoma in Norman on Saturday, Oct. 31, during the 2026 college football season.
article.body:
The Sooners enter the Saturday contest with a defense ranked second in the Southeastern Conference, holding the home-field advantage in Norman. This matchup marks the third time the two programs have squared off in the past three seasons, with the Gamecocks looking to replicate their previous triumph at this venue. Recent history shows South Carolina carrying momentum, having defeated two teams previously ranked in the top-16 this year. 

For both teams, the stakes remain high as they fight to stay in contention for a College Football Playoff berth, requiring them to win out their remaining schedule. The outcome hinges on whether Oklahoma can rebound from earlier season losses to Michigan, Georgia, and Kentucky, or if South Carolina can maintain the winning streak that has defined their last two appearances. The performance of Gamecocks quarterback LaNorris Sellers remains a focal point after his standout play against Tennessee, alongside the defensive pressure provided by edge rusher Dylan Stewart. 

Oklahoma faces internal questions about consistency following a season that saw them alternate between impressive wins and head-scratching losses. On the offensive side, the Sooners rely on quarterback John Mateer, who regained his top form last week behind a bolstered offensive line featuring the returned Michael Fasusi. However, the Gamecocks secondary faces scrutiny after allowing significant coverage gaps in their most recent victory. With neither coaching staff enjoying a comfortable position, the game serves as a pivotal moment to stabilize their respective seasons.

article.headline: Newcastle United eyes top six push against Everton at St James' Park
article.summary: Newcastle United sits eighth in the Premier League table with 11 points and hosts Everton on Monday night.
article.body:
Newcastle United enters Monday night's clash at St James' Park sitting eighth in the Premier League table, having secured 11 points from their opening eight league fixtures. A victory over Everton would propel the team to 14 points, potentially vaulting them as high as fifth place by the end of the round depending on other results involving Leeds, Brentford, and Chelsea.

The current standing challenges the narrative of a season in crisis following a summer of squad realignment and the departure of key players to meet UEFA SCR restrictions. Despite the heavy rotation toward younger, less expensive talent and a change in management, a consistent points average through the remainder of the campaign could yield 59 points, a total that would have secured a top-six finish last season.

While BBC pundit Chris Sutton has predicted a 2-1 defeat for the hosts, citing Newcastle's open tactical approach, the team looks to build on the defensive stability shown in a recent 2-0 win at Crystal Palace. Following a 3-1 Carabao Cup exit on Thursday, the focus for manager Matthias Jaissle turns to limiting the impact of Everton’s forward line, specifically Thierno Barry, who remains a focal point of their attack.

Perspective on the club's trajectory remains a subject of debate among the fanbase as they await Monday’s outcome. With 27 games remaining after this match, the squad aims to stabilize their position in the upper half of the table before the season deepens.

article.headline: Fabio Silva 89th-minute strike snatches draw for Dortmund against Bayern Munich
article.summary: Borussia Dortmund twice rallied to force a 2-2 draw against Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich.
article.body:
Fabio Silva found the bottom left corner with an 89th-minute strike on the turn, silencing the crowd and denying Bayern Munich a victory in Der Klassiker. The late goal capped a frantic ending to a match that saw the lead change hands twice and both teams frequently testing the woodwork.

For Bayern Munich, the result serves as a precarious defense of their position at the top of the Bundesliga table. While they remain ahead of Borussia Dortmund, the lead is now held only by goal difference. Any slip in performance from the league leaders allows the trailing pack to tighten their grip on the standings, making every point crucial in the mid-season race.

According to the BBC, Bayern Munich initially took the lead through Konrad Laimer, who scored after his own rebound was saved. Harry Kane, fresh off winning the Ballon d'Or, struggled to convert his chances, notably hitting the crossbar with a second-half penalty. Dortmund replied through Serhou Guirassy, who leveled the match with a low effort. Dayot Upamecano restored Bayern’s lead with a close-range header, but the home side could not maintain their advantage as Silva’s late heroics secured the draw. Sky Sports confirmed that despite Bayern’s protests regarding a foul in the build-up to the final equalizer, the goal stood as the visitors clawed their way back.

The draw sees both teams separated only by goal difference at the peak of the German league. Bayern Munich continues to operate under the guidance of assistant manager Aaron Danks as head coach Vincent Kompany recovers following his discharge from the hospital earlier this week.

article.headline: Binance co-founder Zhao asks Elon Musk for support after $6.3 billion hack
article.summary: Changpeng Zhao requested that Elon Musk cease mocking the cryptocurrency exchange following a $6.3 billion heist on Thursday.
article.body:
Changpeng Zhao reminded the SpaceX CEO that Binance holds over $1 billion in SpaceX equity, an investment stemming from a previous $500 million stake in the takeover of Twitter. The request for support followed a series of laughing and grimacing emojis posted by Musk on X in response to the record-breaking security breach. Zhao emphasized that this was a poor time to troll the platform as it navigates the aftermath of the theft.

This incident marks the largest cryptocurrency heist ever recorded, according to reports from blockchain firms. The scale of the loss highlights the vulnerability of major digital asset exchanges to state-sponsored entities. With $3 billion in assets already frozen, the exchange is attempting to manage the fallout of an attack currently being attributed to the North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor.

The public dispute between Zhao and Musk follows a history of online friction between the two figures. In 2021, the pair clashed when Musk labeled Binance’s suspension of Dogecoin withdrawals as shady, prompting Zhao to draw a comparison to a massive Tesla vehicle recall. The current tension underscores the delicate relationship between major crypto infrastructure and the tech moguls who frequently comment on the industry.

Binance confirmed on Friday that it has officially restored deposits to the exchange following a temporary freeze of all user activity that was implemented immediately after the hack was detected. The exchange continues to work alongside investigators to address the stolen funds and stabilize the platform for its users worldwide.

article.headline: Strangers Raise Nearly 600,000 Dollars After Viral Prank Targets Pizza Worker
article.summary: A Michigan grocery store employee received massive financial support after a video of him confronting a prankster went viral.
article.body:
Walt Z., a Red Baron worker stocking pizzas at a Meijer store, told an unidentified prankster that his life is hard enough as he works long hours to support his four children. The confrontation occurred when the individual pretended to steal money from him using a fake Apple Pay transaction sound, prompting Walt to explain he had missed time with his family and faced early morning shifts at ten other locations. 

The emotional response triggered a global reaction online, with thousands of people donating to a GoFundMe account to assist him with his financial struggles, including his mortgage payments. The support underscores a widespread public rejection of public pranking behavior that targets hardworking service employees already managing personal and professional stress. 

According to Yahoo and NBC 5 Chicago, the fundraiser has surpassed 480,000 dollars, with NBC 5 reporting the total is nearing 600,000 dollars as of October 30. Red Baron publicly stood by their employee, stating on social media that "employee of the month" nominations are now closed because they already have their winner. 

Walt Z. stated through the fundraiser that he is overwhelmed by the kindness shown to him and his family. While he has received numerous interview requests, he is currently prioritizing his family's privacy and considering his next steps carefully to ensure he is treated with respect.

article.headline: Jaylen Brown remains questionable for Sixers matchup against the Charlotte Hornets tonight
article.summary: Philadelphia 76ers forward Jaylen Brown is listed as questionable for Saturday's road game against the Charlotte Hornets due to left patellar tendinopathy.
article.body: Jaylen Brown’s availability for the Philadelphia 76ers remains uncertain as the team prepares for the second leg of a back-to-back road trip. The forward, who is dealing with left patellar tendinopathy, was listed as questionable in the team’s official injury report released Saturday afternoon following his absence during Friday’s win over the New York Knicks. Brown previously reported soreness in his left knee following a 114-109 victory against the Indiana Pacers on Wednesday. Sixers head coach Nick Nurse has stated that the timetable for Brown’s return depends on his ongoing treatment and pain tolerance, noting that there is no long-term concern regarding the injury. Through his first five games this season, Brown has averaged 20.6 points, 6.6 rebounds, and 4.2 assists. The status of other key roster members adds to the uncertainty for the Sixers in Charlotte. While LeBron James and Joel Embiid are officially ruled out for tonight’s game due to injury management, the team may see the return of Jabari Walker from a knee injury. Additionally, center Tacko Fall is listed as questionable and could potentially make his season debut. The Sixers enter this contest coming off a 98-93 victory on Friday night. The organization will continue to monitor Brown’s condition leading up to tip-off against the Hornets as they navigate a busy schedule that includes upcoming NBA Cup group stage matchups against the Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat, and Indiana Pacers throughout November.

news.og_desc: Arthur Fils has suffered a major and painful setback in his quest to qualify for the ATP Finals 2026. Ranked 7th in the ATP Race (6th if we exclude Sinner), the French player was aware that he needed to accumulate all possible points at the ATP 500 Basel 2026 to pave the way to Turin and feel less pressured in the final Masters 1000 of the year, which will take place next week in Paris.However, he had to retire due to injury from his quarter-final match against Taylor Fritz, raising all alarms regarding the viability of his physical condition to be a key player in this end of the year. There was great interest in knowing his impressions, and the newspaper L`Equipe shared what the French tennis player said in the mixed zone.Fils concerns all of France with his words“I felt a pain in my left leg at the beginning of the match, and it didn't go away as the minutes passed. I asked for a medical timeout, but the treatment I received didn't alleviate the discomfort, so I decided to retire. I want to be optimistic and have confidence. Now, my plan is to go to Paris, get tested, and once I know the results, talk with my team to make the necessary decisions regarding the last tournaments of the year.”Worrisome words from Arthur Fils, suggesting the possibility that a spot for the ATP Finals 2026 could open up if his physical problem is serious. Players who are on the edge of qualifying, like Jódar or Djokovic, will be very attentive to the Frenchman's evolution since they could benefit significantly from a potential withdrawal for the upcoming Masters tournament that will be held in Turin from November 15 to 22.

news.og_title: Tanner uses Cardiff criticism as 'fire' to prove doubters wrong - AOL
news.og_desc: Cardiff City winger Ollie Tanner says people writing them off gives him "fire" to prove them wrong. The Bluebirds have lost just once in their last five games ahead of Saturday's trip to Molineux to face Wolverhampton Wanderers . And despite being amongst the pre-season favourites for relegation with some bookmakers, Cardiff find themselves above Wrexham in the Championship table in 16th place after 12 games. And Tanner, who has scored two goals in his last three games, has revealed the team have used that as motivation. "A lot of people doubted us before this season and wrote us off," the 24-year-old said. "So every game is just another opportunity to show what we can do to the league, to ourselves, to the fans, to everyone. "So, yeah, we see it as another opportunity to prove ourselves. "I love it personally [when people write you off], it gives me more fire to go and prove people wrong. "That's what I've done all my life, so I think a lot of the boys are like that. "When they see people writing you off, it gives you that little bit of extra motivation to go and prove people wrong." Despite starting every Championship game so far this season, Tanner has faced personal criticism from some fans over his performances. But he says it is not something that affects him. "It's football," he added. "People have their opinions and people can say what they want, they're entitled to, it doesn't bother me. "It's the same way that when I'm getting goals and assists and playing well, people are going to big you up. "When you're not playing so well people are going to dig you out. "It's football, you've got to take it. Don't ever get too high when you're doing well and don't ever let yourself get too low when it's not going so well. "You've just got to roll with it." news.title: A Lame-Duck Supreme Court Showdown Could Be Coming
news.og_title: A Lame-Duck Supreme Court Showdown Could Be Coming
news.og_desc:
If Democrats retake the U.S. Senate after the (ongoing) midterm elections, we should expect any number of drastic reactions from Republicans desperate to cling to power. Among them could be a last-ditch effort to extend their control of the Supreme Court by rushing a lame-duck confirmation process in November or December, should Justices Clarence Thomas and/or Samuel Alito (ages 78 and 76, respectively) see it as their last chance anytime soon to be replaced by another conservative.

As we fight to protect our democracy, we must be ready to hold the line.

There hasn’t been a lame-duck Supreme Court confirmation since the 19th century—well before the 12th Amendment standardized the congressional calendar. Such a move would no doubt be seen by the American people as a desperate and unprecedented effort to manipulate the membership of the Supreme Court by bending the rules when it suits them.

Moreover, Republicans' success could become largely irrelevant if Democrats follow through on reforming the Supreme Court after retaking power. 

Support for Supreme Court reform is higher than ever. A recent Marquette Law School poll found massive endorsements for the three most prominent reforms: 89 percent for a strict ethics code, 79 percent for term limits and 53 percent for increasing the number of justices on the bench. Such support would surely only grow in the face of Republicans blatantly attempting to lock in control before losing power.
